note: Hand-edited team file for the Base plan tab. Rule: every number has a named source. A fact with no source has "v": null, and the app shows 'No sourced value' or asks the user to enter one. Terrain, sunlight and Earth-visibility maps are generated by pipeline/build_site_terrain.py into data/siting/<site>.json.
parameters_note: Design parameters are choices the user makes, not measurements. They start empty: the user types them in the Base plan tab. Put a default here only together with a cited source in "src".

losses.label: Other losses: dust, wiring, heat, pointing (0-1)

slope_limit.label: Max slope for building without levelling

long_night_h.label: Night length that triggers the nuclear suggestion

buffer_h.label: Emergency battery buffer when fission is the main supply

artemis.name: Artemis Base Camp
artemis.src: NASA, "Lunar Living: NASA's Artemis Base Camp Concept", 28 Oct 2020
artemis.desc: Quoted on the page: a fixed habitat that "can house up to four astronauts for a month-long stay", and a fission surface power unit that "can continuously provide 10 kW of power". The 10 kW is what the concept supplies, used here as the power need. Design parameters are not given there: type your own.

mars_dra5.name: NASA Mars DRA 5.0
mars_dra5.src: Drake (ed.), Human Exploration of Mars Design Reference Architecture 5.0, NASA NTRS 20100028285
mars_dra5.desc: Quoted in the document: "six crewmembers", "Mars stay time would be 539 days", fission power "on the order of 40 kWe continuously", and "Power system emplaced 1 km from landing location" (used as the reactor distance). Other design parameters are not given there: type your own.

shackleton.name: Shackleton Crater rim
shackleton.center_src: Site marker in index.html (89.9° S, 0° E), near the south pole on the crater rim. Not yet checked against the USGS planetary names gazetteer.

sun_fraction.label: Sunlit share of time at the solar field
sun_fraction.src: From the NASA PGDA sunlight map in the terrain file.

night_hours.label: Longest dark spell to survive
night_hours.src: No sourced value yet: the PGDA maps give averages, not the longest night. Enter one to size batteries.

earth_visible.label: Share of time Earth is visible at the antenna
earth_visible.src: From the NASA PGDA Earth-visibility map in the terrain file.

ice_nearby.label: Permanently shadowed ground nearby
ice_nearby.src: From the NASA PGDA sunlight map: cells never lit.

tranquility.name: Tranquility Base
tranquility.center_src: Apollo 11 landing site 0.67° N, 23.47° E (NASA NSSDC Apollo 11 page, https://nssdc.gsfc.nasa.gov/planetary/lunar/apollo11info.html).

sun_fraction.label: Sunlit share of time
sun_fraction.src: Derived: at the equator day and night are equal halves of the 29.53-day synodic period (NASA Moon Fact Sheet).

night_hours.label: Longest dark spell to survive
night_hours.src: Derived: 29.53 days ÷ 2 × 24 h (NASA Moon Fact Sheet).

earth_visible.label: Share of time Earth is visible
